content.user_title: Compare Live Hotel Prices Across Four Sources
content.value_statement: Comparing hotel prices across several booking sites is slow and inconsistent. This skill searches live sources and presents the cheapest dated options in one view.
actual_capabilities: Starts asynchronous hotel searches using city, stay dates, guest count, and optional filters.
Polls PriceWin results until partial or completed hotel data becomes available.
Compares Agoda, Booking.com, Traveloka, and OpenTravel listings.
Deduplicates matching properties and calculates savings against the next cheapest source.
Adds requested dates and guest counts to supported booking links.
Filters weak listings and presents five to seven low-price options.
limitations: Requires a configured PriceWin MCP server and cannot work without that external tool.
The hosted PriceWin backend is closed-source and receives the travel query.
Prices are shown in USD without currency conversion.
The skill cannot book rooms or guarantee current price and availability.

use_cases.title: Plan a Personal Stay
use_cases.description: Compare affordable hotels for exact dates and open provider pages with the stay details included.

use_cases.title: Research Client Options
use_cases.description: Prepare a concise, source-attributed shortlist for a client without checking each booking site separately.

use_cases.title: Compare Business Travel
use_cases.description: Find well-reviewed properties within a defined price range near a requested business area.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Hotel Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find hotels in {city} from {check-in} to {check-out} for {adults} adults. Show the five cheapest suitable options.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has a destination and fixed travel dates.

prompt_templates.title: Filtered Stay Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search hotels in {city} for {dates}. Keep ratings above {rating} and nightly prices between {minimum} and {maximum} USD.
prompt_templates.scenario: A traveler needs quality and budget filters.

prompt_templates.title: Area Price Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare hotels near {area} for {dates} and {guests}. Deduplicate properties and show each source price with calculated savings.
prompt_templates.scenario: A travel advisor compares providers within one area.

prompt_templates.title: Detailed Multi-Source Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Search {city} for {dates} and poll until complete. Rank qualified hotels by price, explain partial coverage, and include dated provider links.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs complete source coverage and transparent ranking.

best_practices: Provide exact check-in, check-out, and guest details before starting a search.
Wait for completed results when source coverage matters, while presenting useful partial results when available.
Confirm the final price, taxes, and availability on the provider page before booking.
anti_patterns: Do not include names, contact details, payment data, or credentials in search text.
Do not invent booking links or alter returned URLs beyond documented date and guest parameters.
Do not present partial or point-in-time prices as guaranteed availability.

faq.question: Which hotel sources does this skill compare?
faq.answer: It compares Agoda, Booking.com, Traveloka, and OpenTravel results returned by PriceWin.

faq.question: Does the skill require an account or API key?
faq.answer: The documented hosted endpoint requires no account or API key, but the PriceWin MCP server must be configured.

faq.question: What data is sent to PriceWin?
faq.answer: The search sends destination, stay dates, guest count, language, and any requested hotel filters.

faq.question: Can this skill book a hotel?
faq.answer: No. It only searches and displays options with provider links.

faq.question: Are prices guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Prices and availability can change, so users must confirm them on the provider page.

faq.question: Can it convert prices into another currency?
faq.answer: No. The skill presents returned prices in USD without conversion.
